C0609.title: Beijing Youth Daily Tests 21 Apps for Account Re-binding Difficulties, Exposing Gaps in Secondary Number User Rights
C0609.summary: In April 2024, Beijing Youth Daily reporters tested the account re-binding processes of 21 mainstream apps and found inconsistent platform standards. Some apps allowed one phone number to bind multiple accounts, preventing secondary number users from registering new ones.
